    parts: list[str] = []

        parts.append(md.serializer(child))

new_render_inner = '''def render_inner_html(md: Markdown, elem: etree.Element) -> str:
    """Serialize the inner HTML of an element (text + children, not the element itself)."""
    # Create a wrapper element containing the text and children

        wrapper.text = elem.text

new_run = '''    def run(self, doc: etree.Element) -> None:
        # Get a list of id attributes
        used_ids = set()
        for el in doc.iter():
            if "id" in el.attrib:
                used_ids.add(el.attrib["id"])

        toc_tokens = []
        for el in doc.iter():
            if isinstance(el.tag, str) and self.header_rgx.match(el.tag):
                self.set_level(el)
                # Use new helpers instead of deprecated get_name/stashedHTML2text
                inner_html = render_inner_html(self.md, el)
                processed_text = run_postprocessors(self.md, inner_html)
                text = striptags(processed_text)

                # Do not override pre-existing ids
                if "id" not in el.attrib:
                    # Unescape HTML entities and markdown escape sequences before slugifying
                    slug_text = html.unescape(unescape(text))
                    el.attrib["id"] = unique(self.slugify(slug_text, self.sep), used_ids)

                if int(el.tag[-1]) >= self.toc_top and int(el.tag[-1]) <= self.toc_bottom:
                    raw_label = el.attrib.get('data-toc-label')
                    if raw_label:
                        # Use stashedHTML2text to convert escape sequences back to HTML,
                        # then strip tags for plain text name
                        name = stashedHTML2text(code_escape(raw_label), self.md, strip_entities=False)
                        name = striptags(name)
                    else:
                        name = striptags(text)
                    # Unescape markdown escape sequences in name (like original code)
                    name = unescape(name)
                    toc_tokens.append({
                        'level': int(el.tag[-1]),
                        'id': el.attrib["id"],
                        'name': name
                    })

                # Remove the data-toc-label attribute as it is no longer needed
                if 'data-toc-label' in el.attrib:
                    del el.attrib['data-toc-label']

                if self.use_anchors:
                    self.add_anchor(el, el.attrib["id"])
                if self.use_permalinks not in [False, None]:
                    self.add_permalink(el, el.attrib["id"])

        toc_tokens = nest_toc_tokens(toc_tokens)
        div = self.build_toc_div(toc_tokens)
        if self.marker:
            self.replace_marker(doc, div)

        # serialize and attach to markdown instance.
        toc = self.md.serializer(div)
        for pp in self.md.postprocessors:
            toc = pp.run(toc)
        self.md.toc_tokens = toc_tokens
        self.md.toc = toc'''

content = content.replace(old_run, new_run)

with open('markdown/extensions/toc.py', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)
